title: fix(plugin-detail): the record strip is the declared highlights only; the path's stage and the owner show once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb6wxbsWyHo3SfTcNubseV95)_

Fixes #28868

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:记录页的要点条(highlight strip)只画对象声明的 `highlightFields`(去掉标题字段，最多 6 个)。没声明就不画：默认记录页、手机记录头、记录悬停卡三处都一样，字段全部留在正文。路径条(`record:path`)画了阶段字段时，正文不再重复画这个字段。要点条里有 `owner_id` 时，正文下方的元信息行不再重复写负责人。系统字段 `owner_id` 的中文平台标签从「所有者」改为「负责人」,和 ui 的 `detail.owner` 统一。
- **为什么改**:维护者裁决 A1「没声明就不挑」(#28868)。以前没声明时按字段名猜 6 个(owner 打头)并从正文隐藏，小对象的正文因此被掏空;阶段在路径条和正文各出现一次;负责人在要点条和元信息行各出现一次，还用了「所有者」「负责人」两个词。
- **风险与回滚**:低到中。没声明 `highlightFields` 的对象(含 `examples/app-crm`)会失去要点条，直到 #28870 给 app-crm 补声明;HotCRM 已声明。没有新的元数据键，没有新门禁。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`(`deriveHighlightFields`、`headerDrawnFields`、`drawnPathField`)、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordMetaFooter.tsx`(负责人只出现一次)、`synth/__tests__/highlights-declaredOnly-28868.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/highlights-declaredOnly-28868.test.ts packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordMetaFooter.ownerOnce-28868.test.tsx`,预期 2 个文件、19 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **No guessed strip.** `deriveHighlightFields` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`) returns the object's declared `highlightFields` minus the title field (the one `resolveTitleField` names), at most `max`, or `[]`. The preferred-name walk (`owner` / `owner_id` first, then amount, rating, industry, …), the type filter, the system-field skip list, the gated-group skip and the retired-type gate on that walk are deleted, not kept behind a flag. The export and its signature stay. `statusField` is accepted and no longer read; the docblock says so.
- **The three readers follow it.**
  - The default page (`buildDefaultHighlights`, and the body's `hideFields`) asks it as before. An undeclared object now gets no `record:highlights` node and an empty hide list.
  - The phone header (`recordPhoneHeader.ts`) uses `declared ?? []`: no strip and no subtitle when nothing is declared, as on any width.
  - The hover card (`RecordPreviewCard.tsx`) asks `deriveHighlightFields(def, null)`, so an undeclared object shows the title alone. With no key field it now sends no `$expand`. `buildExpandFields` reads an empty column list as "every reference field", which the card would never draw. The new card test caught this.
- **The stage once.** `buildDefaultPageSchema` reads the strip it actually placed: the default one, or an authored `highlights` slot. When that strip holds a `record:path`, its `statusField` joins the Details body's `hideFields`. `buildDefaultTabs` on its own hides what the default strip for the same options draws. Two private helpers do this, `drawnPathField` and `headerDrawnFields`. No public type moves: the exported `buildDefaultTabs` keeps its options type, and the page builder calls a private `synthTabs` with the computed list.
- **The body's hide list is cut at six too** (a bounded in-place fix, same defect class). The strip has always drawn at most six, but `buildDefaultTabs` hid the whole list `RecordDetailView` passes in. So a declared seventh or eighth entry was drawn by neither the strip nor the body. `headerDrawnFields` cuts at `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX`. The fix is pinned, and its ablation goes red.
- **The owner once.** `RecordMetaFooter` leaves the owner out of the meta line when `deriveHighlightFields(objectSchema, null)` holds `owner_id`. Otherwise it keeps it.
- **One word for the owner.** The ui key `detail.owner` and the spec's system-field label of `owner_id` (`SYSTEM_FIELD_LABELS` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) now say the same word in every language both declare:

  | Language | `detail.owner` (ui pack) | `owner_id` (spec) | Change |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | en | Owner | Owner | none |
  | zh-CN | 负责人 | 负责人 (was 所有者) | spec value |
  | ja-JP | 所有者 | 所有者 | none |
  | es-ES | Propietario | Propietario | none |
  | ko, de, fr, pt, ru, ar | 소유자, Inhaber, Propriétaire, Proprietário, Владелец, المالك | (no spec row) | none |

  The seat chose 「负责人」 for zh: the person who follows the record up. Every other language keeps the word its ui pack already uses. None of them is wrong for a record's owner. "Inhaber" is the common German CRM term (Datensatzinhaber). No ui pack value changes. A label an author wrote is still never overridden.

## Tests

- **New: `synth/__tests__/highlights-declaredOnly-28868.test.ts`, 11 cases, rules 1–3.**
  - The card's account (industry, revenue, website, owner, no declared list) gets no strip and an empty body hide list.
  - A declared list is drawn exactly, minus the title, and the body hides exactly those fields. A declared entry past the sixth stays in the body.
  - An opportunity with a path hides `stage` from the body. Controls: `stageField: false`, and a status field with no stages. An authored highlights slot with a path hides the stage, and one without a path does not. `buildDefaultTabs` on its own follows the same rule.
- **New: `__tests__/RecordMetaFooter.ownerOnce-28868.test.tsx`, 8 cases, rules 3 (owner) and 4 (one word).** A declared strip naming `owner_id` drops the owner from the meta line. With no `owner_id` in the strip, or no strip at all, the owner stays. For en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES, `translateObject`'s `owner_id` label equals the matching ui pack's `detail.owner`. 负责人 and Owner are pinned by name.
- **Hover card and phone header.** `RecordPreviewCard.test.tsx` gains "an object that declares no highlightFields shows the title alone". It asserts no guessed field and a bare `findOne` with no `$expand`. In `recordPagePush-27058.test.tsx`, the "no declared highlights" case now asserts `{ subtitle: '', highlightFields: [] }` instead of "derived, at most four".
- **Tests that pinned today's guess, changed:**
  - `__tests__/buildDefaultPageSchema.retiredFieldType.test.ts` is deleted. It pinned the retired-type gate on the two selection passes, and both passes are gone. A retired type is still refused loudly by the form, inline edit and the body (`InlineFieldInput.retiredFieldType.test.tsx` and the field widgets).
  - `deriveHighlightFields.groupGate-12720.test.ts` is rewritten. An undeclared object has no strip at all, a declared gated entry is left as written, and the page body hides nothing and draws the gated group.
  - `buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts`: the four heuristic cases become one "nothing is guessed" case, and the title-skip case now uses a declared list. The retired `compactLayout` case now expects `[]`. Three page and sub-builder cases use a `declaredLeadDef`, and the unused `getRecordDisplayName` import is dropped.
  - In `buildDefaultPageSchema.strictPayload.test.ts` and `record-highlights.groupGate-12720.test.tsx`, the fixtures declare the strip they render.
  - In `resolveTitleField.sharedLadder-7287.test.ts`, three strip cases declare their fields, so the title skip still decides.
- **The label pins move from 所有者 to 负责人**: spec `i18n-resolver.test.ts` (the custom-label case now uses 客户经理, so it still proves an author's label wins), rest `meta-object-injected-column-i18n.test.ts`, and the app-shell `DraftChangesPanel.generatedGroup-25890.test.tsx` fixture that mirrors the read.

## Acceptance notes

- **app-crm loses its strips until #28870.** `examples/app-crm` declares no `highlightFields`. #28870 declares them (same seat, in parallel); app-crm is not edited here.
- **Phone width, owner in the 5th or 6th declared slot.** The meta line asks the declared strip, which holds at most six fields. On a phone, the header shows at most four after its subtitle. So an object declaring `owner_id` fifth or sixth, behind four non-text highlights, names the owner in neither place on a phone. Closing that needs `RecordDetailView` to hand the footer the strip it drew. That file is outside this card's surface, and `domain:ui#1` holds it for #28483. carrier: seat.
- **An authored `highlights` slot** still leaves the body hiding the declared list, as before. Only the stage half now follows the slot.
- **Release-owned text** (`packages/*/CHANGELOG.md`) still describes the old heuristic in released entries. It is not edited.

## Verification

All readings are on this branch. The final head is `f8e75710`, a merge of `main` (11 commits, none touching this diff's files except an unrelated `cancelText` hunk in `i18n-resolver.ts`), unless a block names another head.

First run 3 files / 7 tests red, all fixtures that relied on the guess to draw a strip: `strictPayload` coverage, three `buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts` page cases, and the three `record-highlights.groupGate-12720` legs. After the fixtures declare their strip: 17/17 re-run, 204 tests.

Two batches at `--maxWorkers=3`: 138/138 files (1380 tests), then 127 files with 1 red. The red was the new hover-card pin: an undeclared object sent `$expand: ['account']`. Fixed in `d4833e5a`, and `record-preview/` re-ran 3/3 files, 43 tests. This is a declared narrowing; CI's Test UI runs the rest of app-shell.

2. The path's stage not pushed into the hide list: 3 red (path page, authored slot, `buildDefaultTabs`).
3. The hide list not cut at six: 1 red (the past-sixth case).
4. The footer ignoring the strip: 1 red (strip naming `owner_id`).
5. The hover card expanding with no key field: 1 red (the new card case).
6. The phone header guessing again: 1 red (the no-declared case).
7. The spec label back to 所有者: 4 red in spec `i18n-resolver.test.ts`.

The ui cross-package pin (`detail.owner` equals the spec label) reads `@objectstack/spec`'s dist, so leg 7 was run on the spec's own suite, which reads source.
